name: Axera Semiconductor Co., LTD.
summary: Axera Semiconductor Co., LTD. provides perception and computing platform in Mainland China and internationally. It offers on-device computing chips, including visual perception SoCs, smart vision chips, lite smart series, and industrial series; smart vehicle chips; and Edge AI Inference chips. In addition, the company provides technology platforms. Axera Semiconductor Co., LTD. was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Ningbo, China.
